findings.title: Legacy removal reports objects removed that may still be there
findings.intended: `removed` is whether the object was dropped (specs/262-ivg-owned-sql-schema/data-model.md:50-60).
findings.remedy: Set `removed` from _drop's result for views and from the class delete's result for every item of that class; a unit case where DROP VIEW raises.
findings.notes: Reproduced by running the pin's remove_legacy_objects against a fake connection whose DROP VIEW and class delete fail (no IRIS: a 4.5.x legacy object set cannot be produced in AUDITA without installing objects). Model ins_legacy (INS-I7.6) violates as built and passes reviewed.

observed.verdict: view and second SqlProc item reported removed although every drop/delete failed
observed.oracle: removed is True only for an object that was dropped or deleted
observed.source: remove_legacy_objects sets removed=True after DROP VIEW without reading _drop's result and for every later item of a class once the class was handled (iris_vector_graph/_engine/legacy.py:666-686).

findings.title: Some setup failures are only logged, not put in the reply's warnings
findings.intended: ADMIN_GUIDE (docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md:428): `warnings` lists what you must act on, each also logged at WARNING.
findings.remedy: Append each of these to status['warnings']; a unit test that makes one CREATE TABLE fail with a non-tolerated error.
findings.notes: Not provoked live: making a CREATE TABLE fail in AUDITA needs a privilege or catalog change on the shared container (forbidden). Model ins_setup check ins_setup-as-built-F0102 (INS-B1.12) violates as built.
findings.observed: A base DDL failure other than already-exists/privilege is a log line (iris_vector_graph/_engine/schema.py:2506-2511); a failed ALTER ... emb VECTOR goes to report['failed'] and a log line (1666-1671); a failed ^KG bootstrap is a log line (2680-2681). Re-read at the pin.

findings.title: The first-use check accepts a namespace with no schema record
findings.intended: Spec 262 FR-006a (specs/262-ivg-owned-sql-schema/spec.md:245): refuse when the namespace has no schema record or lacks the 4.6.0 objects; HD-0101 (supported) separates an unreadable record (warn) from a readable mismatch (refuse).
findings.remedy: Refuse when no record exists whatever the marker says (setup exempt), or amend FR-006a and the ADMIN_GUIDE to say the marker alone is accepted.
findings.notes: docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md:787-809 accepts the behaviour; the spec and the known issue conflict (S3).

observed.verdict: accepted with no record (marker class present)
observed.oracle: FR-006a: an engine refuses a namespace with no schema record (setup exempt)

findings.title: Spec 240 says its design was not adopted, but it ships
findings.intended: A spec's status line describes the shipped code.
findings.remedy: Update the spec status or remove the module.
findings.observed: specs/240-alt-migration-as-data/spec.md:6 'Status: Exploratory (alternative implementation; not adopted)'; iris_vector_graph/migrations/docs_and_edge_vectors.py:53 imports iris_vector_graph.migrations.statements.

findings.title: The SQL files under sql/ describe an old schema and put objects outside the IVG Schema
findings.intended: Spec 262 FR-001/FR-002 (spec.md:231-233): IVG creates nothing outside the IVG Schema; HD-0103 (assumption): packaged SQL loaded by the legacy deployer is reachable.
findings.remedy: Per HD-0103: bring the legacy deployer to parity or retire it; mark the historical files.
findings.notes: Not run: executing the legacy deployer would create objects outside the IVG Schema in a shared container.
findings.observed: sql/schema.sql:4-7 creates Graph_KG.nodes keyed by node_id alone; scripts/deploy_production.py:65 still runs sql/schema.sql and sql/operators_fixed.sql.

findings.title: Property keys of a label mix graphs
findings.intended: CONTEXT.md:38-43 / SYS-I2: an all-graphs read is the union of each graph's own answer; content of one graph never answers about another.
findings.remedy: Join rdf_labels to rdf_props on (graph_id, s); a test with one id in two graphs.
findings.notes: The docstring now says 'Not graph-scoped'; the join by id alone still lists a key no node with the label holds.

observed.verdict: graph B's key listed under graph A's label
observed.oracle: every key listed for label L is held by a node with L in its own graph

findings.title: Every setup runs an unqualified DROP INDEX
findings.intended: Spec 262 FR-007 (spec.md:246-248): IVG's SQL names only IVG Schema objects, fully qualified.
findings.remedy: Qualify it (DROP INDEX idx_props_key_val ON <schema>.rdf_props) or drop the step.
findings.notes: The live observation lists every index of that name in AUDITA and the process's default schema; whether IRIS would drop an application's SQLUser index of that name was not tried (it would need a SQLUser object).

observed.oracle: spec 262 FR-007: IVG's SQL names only fully qualified objects in the IVG Schema
observed.source: iris_vector_graph/schema.py:657 ('DROP INDEX idx_props_key_val') in ensure_indexes; no schema token, so the SchemaCursor rewrite leaves it unqualified.
observed.note: the probe did not decide (crashed or observation only)

findings.title: The upstream test deploy does not follow setup's skip rules
findings.intended: docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md:353: IRIS Community is supported; initialize_schema skips classes whose %AI dependencies are absent.
findings.remedy: Have the fixture call initialize_schema() or apply select_classes; a CI job on Community.
findings.notes: Test-infrastructure finding; the completion audit uses the pin's initialize_schema for deployment.
findings.observed: tests/conftest.py:215-262 compiles every class under iris_src/src and raises on any failure; setup skipped Graph.KG.MCPService/MCPToolSet/MCPTools in AUDITA ($RUN_DIR/setup/deploy-AUDITA.json).

findings.title: The 4.0.0 upgrade does not follow the namespace's schema
findings.intended: ADR-0016 (docs/adr/0016-one-ivg-schema-per-namespace.md:10-12): the schema name chosen at install is followed by everything.
findings.remedy: Read the record (refuse a mismatch) or document Graph_KG-only.
findings.notes: A live upgrade needs a 3.x fixture namespace; not available (blocked-access for a live run: the orchestrator owns namespaces).
findings.observed: iris_vector_graph/migrations/upgrade.py:58 DEFAULT_SCHEMA = 'Graph_KG' and :140 schema default; ^IVG.Deploy('schema') is never read.

findings.title: ADR-0016 lags the shipped design
findings.intended: A decision record states the shipped mechanism and API names.
findings.remedy: Amend the ADR's status and consequences.
findings.observed: docs/adr/0016-one-ivg-schema-per-namespace.md:5 'implementation pending: spec 262'; :26 names remove_legacy_sql_objects while the method is remove_legacy_objects (iris_vector_graph/_engine/admin.py:378).

findings.title: An inline relationship property in a Cypher pattern fails on an edge with no properties
findings.intended: openCypher: MATCH (x)-[r:R {k: 0}]->(y) and MATCH (x)-[r:R]->(y) WHERE r.k = 0 are equivalent; a missing property makes the filter false, not an error. create_edge's docstring: omitted properties leave the property null.
findings.remedy: Guard Graph_KG.JSON_VALUE against an empty/NULL document (as CY_REL_PROP does), or emit the guarded function in _merge_prop_preds; a Cypher test over an edge written by create_edge without properties.
findings.notes: New. Graph_KG.JSON_VALUE (DDL at iris_vector_graph/schema.py:2185, created by setup: module 01) calls %FromJSON on NULL and then %Get on a non-object: <INVALID OREF>, SQLCODE -149. Inline MATCH and inline DELETE fail; the WHERE form answers []. Any edge written without properties (create_edge, store_edge, bulk paths) is a trigger. The Cypher translation belongs to module 08; reported here because the failing object is setup's DDL.

observed.verdict: inline form raises SQLCODE -149 on NULL qualifiers
observed.oracle: an inline relationship property filter answers like the equivalent WHERE filter
